title: Platform COE value microdeck (WIP)
content:
Slide 1 - Title: Platform COE Value Microdeck (WIP)
Speaker note: one-pager mini-deck for platform/COE leads who evaluate inference at org scale. Keep <10 slides, focused on ops levers and quick wins.

Slide 2 - Problem framing
- Platform teams inheriting fragmented model endpoints, unpredictable cost, and no rollout standard.
- Typical asks: 'How to guarantee latency + control cost while giving product teams flexibility?'
- Pain signals: rising token spend, shadow deployments, incident hotfixes that bypass governance.

Slide 3 - What COE cares about (quick checklist)
- Predictable unit economics (cost/1000 tokens)
- Latency SLAs per route and region
- Auditability (who called what model)
- Safe rollouts: canary, A/B, auto-fallback
- Simple migration story for teams

Slide 4 - Redwood value pillars for COE
- Unified API across hosted/dedicated/private -> single governance layer
- Routing policies + cost-aware fallbacks -> preserve SLOs during capacity events
- Observability: token-level cost and slow-path tracing for ops playbooks
- Optimize: model/quantization recommendations tailored to workloads

Slide 5 - Small pilot (4-week plan)
Week 0: kickoff, map 2 product routes + current cost baseline (tooling: console export)
Week 1: enable routing policy + prefix caching on 1 route, measure latency and spend delta
Week 2: run canary rollout with automatic fallback to cheaper variant under load
Week 3: capture dashboards, present COE scorecard (latency, cost delta, error rate)
Outcome: 10-20% cost reduction on targeted routes, <5% latency regression.

Slide 6 - Demo script (5 minutes)
- Show console: route definition, policy button, canary toggle
- Trigger synthetic traffic (stage): observe tracing, confirm fallback triggers
- Open cost panel: show instant token-level breakdown for the route
Speaker tip: keep the demo tiny — platform folks want to see control + observability fast.

Slide 7 - Quick battlecard snippets (for AE/SEs)
Q: 'How do we keep latency at p99 under 300ms?'
A: Use region pinning + low-latency variant with routing policy; enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts.
Q: 'Will this break our audit or compliance?'
A: Control plane records model, route, and request metadata; integrates with KMS and SIEM via audit logs.
Objection reframes: call out cost vs unit economics, not just list price.

Slide 8 - Risk & mitigations
- Risk: product teams resist constraints -> Mitigation: offer a sandboxed dev route and a migration playbook.
- Risk: initial telemetry gaps -> Mitigation: short instrumentation spike, deliver a templated dashboard.

Slide 9 - Next steps / asks
- Ask COE: pick 2 routes and a small pilot team (Platform, Search, Chat)
- Deliverable: 4-week pilot, final deck + playbook for scaling to org
- Success metric: measurable cost reduction, and demonstrated rollback/fallback worked in production.

Appendix - Notes to self / TODOs
- Add real pilot numbers from prior Dedicated PoC (ask Marco for baseline CSV).
- Create a lightweight migration checklist (tickets for infra, security review, and SE handshake).
- Link a canned dashboard template and synthetic load script in GitHub repo.
- Draft email template to COE sponsor for kickoff.

References & links to artifacts:
- Confluence: platform-coe/pilot-plan (will link once created)
- Jira: PROD-987 (proposed pilot epic)

Internal style notes: keep slides intentionally minimal; this deck is a live sales tool for SRE/Platform leads — expect to iterate after first two pilots. Marked WIP until pilot run 1 complete.
